primary_scope: All original lineage labels, all35 genes, separately within study and technology; no highest-expression selection
secondary_scope: All remaining observed original annotation/enrichment/technology strata, including unpaired or low-coverage rows
pairing: Exact original patient ID within identical study/enrichment/technology/annotation/type; absent side excluded never zero
normalization: Reuse total-library pseudobulk CPM from exact patient aggregates; no imputation,pseudocount,log or new batch correction
test: Two-sided exact sign test: positive among nonzero paired CPM differences under probability0.5; zero differences retained in effects and excluded from binomial denominator; all-zero p1
estimand: median paired CPM difference T-N; p tests direction among non-ties, not magnitude; ties may make CI and P target differ
ci: Distribution-free order-statistic median interval with coverage >=95%; ties conservative; available at n>=6
threshold_rationale: At six pairs smallest two-sided sign P=0.03125 and finite median CI coverage >=95%; coverage threshold is not a power claim
multiplicity: BH across all evaluable35-gene combinations within each study x primary/secondary tier, pooling technologies in family; no separate BH for selected genes; no detection tests
privacy: n<3 no numeric expression summaries; n3-5 descriptive effects without P/q/CI
limitations: Relative CPM not absolute abundance or count-model logFC
Normal tissue is adjacent reference not healthy independent population
Observational state comparison not causal effect
Broad cell classes may differ in substate composition
Separate technologies are not independent validation cohorts
